description: Hostile cases from the security review of PR #575 (Paco's agent's ajv probe and its findings). refusedBy: schema = the published JSON Schema refuses it (checked with ajv); validator = only Durbar's validator can see it (it needs the source, the layer or another file) and the test asserts both verdicts.
